main_text.l: quemadmodum Hebr. iii. 9, ita 1. Corinth. x,9. Addimus illud de vindicta Deo propria, Deuter. xxxii. 35; totidem prolatum verbis, in Epistola ad Hebræos, Cap. x; 30. & in ea quæ est ad Romanos, C. xii. 19. Etiam locus ille, ἐ[?]ν' Ἰσαὰκ κληθήσεταί σοι σπέρμα[?]. Genes. xxii[?].9. legitur allegatus, cum ad Romanos C. ix, 7. tum Hebræos, C. xi,18. Exempla id genus alia, apposi-tissima sanè in rem nostram, sed cum lectoris tædio & naufea reponenda, con-scio studio prætermisimus.

VI. Quartò, mirè author noster luxuriat, in urgendis Patriarcharum exemplis, Abrahami cum primis, hujus fi-de inculcanda, & promissione gratiæ fa-cta illius in semine. Patet Epistolæ Cap. vi, 13, 14, 15. Cap. xi. 8, 9, 10, &c. Quæ quàm apprimè quadrent, cum iis quæ habet Paulus, in sua ad Romanos, Cap. iv, 17. &c. haud prolixè opus est o-stendere. 1. Utrobique prædicatur fi-des Abrahami, digna omni admiratio-ne & omni præconio. ii. Fundamentum illius,

"xxii" in "Genes. xxii.9." is only partly clear. "prætermisimus" is read from the scan and may be a printing variant. Catchword "illius," and signature "M 2" are taken from the foot of the page.
